summary: Aggregate metering fingerprint mismatch leading to misapplied credit on monthly invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer LexiconAI reports an unexpected credit reversal and a net charge on their finalized monthly invoice for Feb 2026. They were previously issued a provisional +$1,420 credit on 2026-02-28 labeled 'aggregate-metering-warmup-credit' which was applied to their invoice on 2026-03-01. On 2026-03-05 the credit shows as reversed and an invoice adjustment of -$1,420 appears as a charge.

Impact:
- Customer budgeted around the provisional credit; reversal caused immediate negative balance and a billing alert to the customer finance team.
- Customer is on Dedicated tier and reports downstream reconciliation failures with their accounting system.

Environment:
prod - us-east (dedicated cluster dcap-lex-01)

Initial hypothesis:
Preliminary triage suggests a change in metering fingerprint generation during a policy refresh on 2026-03-02 caused hourly aggregation keys for a subset of embed jobs to be reclassified. That reclassification made previously grouped warmup microbatches look like distinct meter lines, triggering duplicate postback suppression logic to misattribute credits and then cause a retroactive reconciliation that reversed the provisional credit.

Customer statements (from email thread):
- "We saw a provisional credit and then it vanished; our ledger shows a negative line item for Mar 5."
- "This affects month-end close and we need a full audit trail for our finance team."
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer runs large concurrent embed warmup job across 10 nodes using org key X.
2) Metering service aggregates hourly postbacks into fingerprint groups.
3) On 2026-03-02 a config push expanded fingerprint inputs to include 'quantization_profile' for policy reasons.
4) Same warmup traffic now hashes to two different aggregation keys across the boundary, which triggers dedup and credit reallocation paths during nightly reconciliation.

Observed result: provisional credit applied then reversed with corresponding invoice adj.
Expected result: provisional credit persists or is reconciled without reversal for identical logical traffic.

investigation_notes:
2026-03-10 09:20 - Billing eng: Replayed reconciliation for customer with original and new fingerprinting rules. Found that ~6% of hourly postbacks changed key due to quantization_profile defaulting from 'none' -> 'auto' in the policy push.
2026-03-10 11:00 - Metering eng: Confirmed hash_input change introduced on deploy 2026-03-02. Deploy included a migration step that should have backfilled legacy fingerprints but backfill failed for streams with late-arriving headers.
2026-03-11 14:42 - SRE: Nightly reconciler has a race condition when reassigning provisional credits across newly split aggregation keys; it will consume a provisional credit ledger entry and mark it reversed if the split results in net-zero contribution on the new keys. This is the reversal path that hit LexiconAI.
Preliminary root cause: Policy refresh expanded fingerprint entropy without safe backfill; reconciler logic doesn't treat provisional credits as idempotent across fingerprint splits.
customer_communication:
2026-03-10 12:05 - Initial response sent by CS (Elena Martinez) acknowledging the issue, requesting permission to escalate and share an audit CSV.
2026-03-11 15:10 - Follow-up: provided interim explanation of fingerprint change and committed to a full audit and either reapply the credit or issue a billing adjustment.
2026-03-12 10:30 - Customer requested documented evidence and asked for expedited assurance that month-end close impact will be remedied by 2026-03-15.
actions_taken:
- Scoped repro on staging with replayed postbacks (confirmed reproduction).
- Rolled forward a fix in metering service to treat provisional credits as 'sticky' across key splits (hotfix pr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/714).
- Opened a reconciler follow-up task to add safe-backfill detection to deployment migrations (INT-44421).
- Generated audit CSV with original and post-split meter lines for LexiconAI and uploaded to secure share.
- Finance coordinated with billing ops to prepare a manual invoice adjustment if automated reapply fails.
comments: Elena Martinez (CS, 2026-03-10): Acknowledged and escalated. Requesting check against other customers on the same cluster.
Rajiv Patel (Billing Eng, 2026-03-10): Replayed nightly reconciler and confirmed reversal path. Marking as P1 due to invoice impact.
Maya Chen (Metering Eng, 2026-03-11): Hotfix merged to treat provisional credits as sticky. Will monitor next reconciliation run.
LexiconAI Billing (customer, 2026-03-11): Requested a CSV audit and ETA for credit reapplication.
resolution: In progress: Hotfix PR merged and deployed to prod on 2026-03-12; reconciler run scheduled for 2026-03-13 03:00 UTC to attempt automated reapply of provisional credits. If run fails, billing ops will issue manual credit +$1,420 and provide accounting memo to LexiconAI. Follow-up task (INT-44421) created to add automated backfill detection and a canary validation step for future fingerprint changes.
postmortem_action_items: Add canary validation to fingerprint schema changes (owner: Metering) - INT-44421
Improve reconciler idempotency with respect to provisional credits (owner: Billing) - PR#716
Run a sweep for other dedicated customers who received provisional credits in the 2026-03-01 window (owner: CS/BI)
Document fingerprint input list and change process in Confluence and require runbook sign-off before deployment
